subject: Runtime Orchestra: onboarding playcall - schema & toolcall plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha@healthbridge.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Runtime Orchestra: onboarding playcall - schema & toolcall plan

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for the discovery call last week. To keep momentum, can we schedule a 30-min onboarding playcall to align on the feature enablement scope (streaming + function/tool calling + structured JSON outputs) and freeze the initial schema?

Proposed agenda (30 mins):
- 5 min: introductions & success criteria (HealthBridge)
- 10 min: streaming flow & KV/prefix caching expectations
- 10 min: function/tool calling edge cases and error handling
- 5 min: next steps + mutual action plan (owners + dates)

Pre-reqs for a productive session:
- Your sample API payloads / representative utterances (if available)
- Any security or residency constraints (Camila, please add if we need a privacy contact)
- We'll attach a draft schema and a short streaming test plan for you to try before the call (attached: RBW-schema-draft-v0.2.json; MAP-HealthBridge.xlsx)

If you can share 2-3 slots, I’ll lock a meeting. We’re available Tue 8/17 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 8/18 14:00–15:00 PT.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
Attachment: RBW-schema-draft-v0.2.json (application/json - 14 KB)
Attachment: MAP-HealthBridge.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet - 28 KB)

We’ll aim to have a small technical pair on the call (me + one engineer).

— Asha

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha@healthbridge.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T17:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime Orchestra: onboarding playcall - schema & toolcall plan

Great — confirmed Tue 8/17 10:00 PT. I captured a concise internal playbook below so we’re aligned before the meeting. I’ve attached a small schema draft and a one-page streaming test that HealthBridge can run against our sandbox.

Onboarding playbook (short):
- Owner (Redwood): Camila (CS) — drive MAP and milestone tracking
- Owner (Customer): Asha — product/integration sign-off + procurement lead
- Runtime/Infra: Sergio — responsible for streaming QoS and toolcall runtime checks
- SRE/Scale: Monica — latency/throughput acceptance criteria and stress test owner

Minimal deliverables before the call:
- HealthBridge: one representative payload + expected structured output example (JSON)
- Redwood: schema_v1.json (attached) + streaming_test_instructions.md (attached)

Proposed initial JSON schema highlights (for discussion):
- root: { conversation_id: string, timestamp: ISO8601, source: enum }
- messages[]: array of objects with fields { token_count:int, segments: array, tools_called: array }
- structured_outputs: object with typed fields (patient_id:string|null, diagnosis_codes: array[string], confidence:float)
- tool_call: { name:string, input_schema:object, expected_response_schema:object, retry_policy: { max_attempts:int } }

Edge cases to confirm on the call:
- How to represent partial streaming outputs (delta frames) vs final output
- Tool-call timeouts and fallback semantics (should we emit structured partials?)
- Whether customer wants canonicalized field names or to preserve upstream keys

Attachments: schema_v1.json (attached, 9 KB), streaming_test_instructions.md (attached, 3 KB)

Action items (post-call):
- Freeze schema v1 for pilot (owner: Camila, target: 2026-08-20)
- Provide a short test dataset (owner: Asha, target: 2026-08-19)
- Procurement to confirm contract timeline (procurement - HealthBridge)

Camila Reyes
Client Success Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachment: schema_v1.json (application/json - 9 KB)
Attachment: streaming_test_instructions.md (text/markdown - 3 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha@healthbridge.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime Orchestra: onboarding playcall - schema & toolcall plan

Thanks Camila — looks good. Two quick clarifications before the call so we can prep notes: 

1) Function/tool-calling: do we want a single standardized tool_call envelope for all external integrations (preferred), or allow per-tool ad-hoc input schemas? If the latter, we should agree on a versioning policy.

2) Streaming behavior: when we emit partial frames, will the downstream expect monotonically increasing offsets or timestamps? Sergio, can you confirm Redwood’s current delta-frame contract (KV cache behavior + prefix reuse)?

3) Model selection & quantization: will Redwood propose a default quantization/profile for the pilot, or does HealthBridge want to specify a model family? Suggest we include a short model-recommendation appendix in the call materials (I can draft).

I’ll draft a 1-page runbook for the call and drop it in the meeting invite.

— Karthik
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
